population: All PROV-JSON in five pinned project path sets in source-lock.json. Treat regression fixtures and older eep case studies / package examples as separate strata; original RDataTracker and rdtLite runs often repeat scripts. Do not claim natural coding-agent use. No execution or inspection of user programs outside scalar tokenization. Log empty/malformed/missing tables and all exclusions.
endpoint: For each used entity that instrumentation links to exactly one prior producing activity, derive reference (producer activity, consumer activity) by native version ID. Only atomic Data entities (single number/logical/string), not functions, external-file, snapshots or compound collections. Include all recorded consumers historically after producer whatever activity type; include non-reading consumers in statement-text precision at all eligible chronological contexts. True dynamic-origin edge vs temporally unique observable value are intentionally different semantics.
primary: Conditional experiment: input card=exact scalar value recorded as read, producer identity stripped. Gold hidden native entity and source ID; existence of read and value provided by benchmark builder, so tests ambiguity conditional on known reads, not discovery. Universal prior producing activity, chronological unique until read, revoke uniqueness at later collision, latest writer by value, by binding name, by binding+scope (identity-like controls), version-ID oracle (feasibility only), seeded permuted origins for candidate-size matched sham. Evaluate at consumption and finalized prefix for same historical dependency. Strong primary comparison F1 and precision/recall for global retroactive uniqueness vs query-time uniqueness, plus latest value. Also events at observation with multiple candidate producers, and first candidate subsequently invalidated. Score per read reference/native entity, count TP/FP/FN/missed, macro per script family and paired cluster bootstrap seeded 2209 (5,000).
independent: Second interface predicts producer–consumer pairs directly from raw instrumented statement expression (not used edges or read values); candidate writes observable when executed. Compare literal mentions (unique and universal) and symbol mentions (all/unique/append/latest), plus matched sham. Use normalized numeric and exact character/logical tokens, mask quoted strings/comments and assignment LHS where identifiable; report parser boundaries, distinguish unsupported cases. Public logs contain only redacted integer IDs and counts, not words or values.
strata: source kind, ambiguous-before-read, future-collision-only, never ambiguous, graph-positive-only and all. Distinct trace/pair denominators; aggregate positive samples clustered by original script family rather than pooling both collectors as independent. No tunable parameters/seeds/stop rule. No runtime speed or SOTA claim.
